reading.requirement: Current exact source SHA and evidence offsets must match.

listening.requirement: Question evidence uses spoken transcript spans only. Canonical source usage, official paired Conversation audio, rights and alignment gates remain required. No actual independent audio listen was performed during question authoring.

modalityPolicy.independentExposure: Same-source text/audio share one group. These public practice candidates are not independent assessment or unseen-transfer evidence.

questions.prompt: Why does Anna want to speak to her co-workers today?
options: To apologize for the previous day.
To invite them to her apartment.
To ask them to change jobs.
answers: To apologize for the previous day.
questions.evidence: Today I want to apologize to my co-workers.
questions.explanation: Anna开头直接说今天想向同事apologize，即为昨天的事情道歉。文中没有邀请同事到公寓；结尾提到自己仍保住工作，也不是要求同事换工作。

spokenEvidence.quote: Today I want to apologize to my co-workers.

questions.prompt: What does Jonathan say the studio light means?
options: He is recording his evening show.
The studio is free for a visit.
answers: He is recording his evening show.
questions.evidence: When the studio light is on, I am recording my evening show.
questions.explanation: Jonathan明确把灯亮与正在录制晚间节目联系起来。录制进行中不同于节目已经结束；他随后还说忙、让Anna改日参观，所以灯亮也不是可以自由参观的信号。

spokenEvidence.quote: When the studio light is on, I am recording my evening show.

questions.prompt: When does Amelia suggest Anna should come back?
questions.evidence: It’s okay, Anna. Come by this afternoon.
questions.explanation: Amelia说Come by this afternoon，建议Anna今天下午再来，因此填this afternoon。其他同事提到的时间不能替换这句具体邀请；也不是第二天。

spokenEvidence.quote: It’s okay, Anna. Come by this afternoon.

questions.prompt: When does Caty ask Anna to come to her office?
questions.explanation: Caty用My office. 5:00 p.m.简短给出地点和时间，要求下午五点到办公室。上午十点属于Anne之前的工作说明，不能移给Caty；中午十二点未被提及。

questions.prompt: What happens when Anna goes into the office?
options: She is asked to record Jonathan’s show.
She is told to leave her job.
Her co-workers surprise her with a party.
answers: Her co-workers surprise her with a party.
questions.explanation: 同事喊Surprise，Anna随即说A party，说明这里准备的是惊喜聚会。她接着庆幸自己仍有工作，不能选被要求离职；录制节目是前面Jonathan忙碌的原因，不是这次办公室聚会的任务。

review.textEvidence: Codex item-by-item exact source evidence and language comparison

blindComparison.scope: Independent source-text blind solve before seeing keys. VOA12 then received an explicitly recorded punctuation-only source correction; all question facts and answers were rechecked unchanged.
